channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLhealthAndWellness, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Lower referral threshold for outpatient hyperkalemia may reduce mortality
item.description: Patients who visited the emergency department within 24 hours of severe outpatient hyperkalemia had lower rates of immediate and short-term death.

item.title: AI scribes show mixed effects on documentation time and physician well-being
item.description: Lukac and colleagues compared two ambient AI scribes with usual documentation approaches in outpatient clinical visits. Both AI scribes showed mixed results.

item.title: Ecopipam reduces relapse risk in pediatric Tourette syndrome
item.description: Ecopipam is a first-in-class investigational selective dopamine D1 receptor antagonist under priority review for pediatric Tourette syndrome.

item.title: AI-powered app lowers high blood pressure when part of care plan
item.description: A free smartphone app with AI-driven health coaching, blood pressure monitoring and behavioral incentives was integrated into a hospital's existing care plan.
